2026-05-12 — T2Helix install-path bug compounds with a NEW finding on Mac Studio /Users/tony_studio seat. Session restarted with t2helix marketplace-installed (commit 97da060). MCP tool calls return: 'Could not locate the bindings file' — the better-sqlite3 native binding is not compiled in the plugin cache. Same surface symptom as /Users/vaquez cold-seat dogfood from 2026-05-12. Confirmed: install-path bug reproduces per-seat (binding compilation is not portable across plugin caches).

HOWEVER, the /Users/vaquez fix (npm rebuild better-sqlite3 in the cache dir) FAILS on this seat. Node version is the difference. /Users/vaquez ran 'nvm use 22' before install per README. tony_studio seat runs under Homebrew default Node v26.0.0. better-sqlite3 v11.10.0 (the version pinned in t2helix's package.json) does not compile against Node 26 — V8 API deprecation errors at native build:

  /Users/tony_studio/Library/Caches/node-gyp/26.0.0/include/node/v8-external.h:54: 'Value' has been explicitly marked deprecated
  make: *** [Release/obj.target/better_sqlite3/src/better_sqlite3.o] Error 1
  gyp ERR! stack Error: make failed with exit code: 2

This is a SECOND, distinct install-path failure mode, not the same bug. The chronicle from /Users/vaquez correctly noted 'Node v26 gets a legible error instead of a gyp wall' — but the cold-seat dogfood worked there because nvm use 22 was run first. On a Node-26 plugin runner with no version switch, install is broken at the gyp layer regardless of rebuild attempts.

Fix paths:
  (a) Bump better-sqlite3 pin to a Node 26-compatible version (likely 12.x line) in t2helix package.json. Cleanest.
  (b) Ship a Node version requirement in plugin metadata + a clearer install-time check.
  (c) Switch Mac Studio's plugin-runner Node to v22 via nvm and document the constraint.

Until fixed, t2helix MCP tools are not available on tony_studio seat. Bridge endpoint (port 8100) remains the working path for chronicle writes — autorecord hooks unavailable in this session. Retrospective audit work continues via bridge as in /Users/vaquez dogfood pre-fix.
